Maria G: Heads up — noticed a cluster of provisional credits for reconnects this morning that look correlated with truncated streaming sessions. :eyes:
AJ: Can you paste an example trace?
Maria G: sure — core log snippet from router: `INFO resume_session id=abc123 prefix_trim=32 fallback=region-b` then `SESSION_RESUME toolcall=1 provisional_credit=14`
Jon P: That pattern (resume after prefix_trim) rings a bell. We might be re-attributing the prefix tokens as new work when the session reconnects.
Kevin L: We log `resume` events but the ledger consumer seems to treat them as fresh charges if `session_id` changes. Do we surface session_id in the console traces now?
Maria G: Not consistently — telemetry currently only tags `tracelet_id` and `router_shard`. The ledger event has `session_hint` but it's optional. Ops-bot: incident#824 created: "provisional-credit-spike-on-resume" assigned to eng-platform.
AJ: Quick repro idea: force a reconnect with a truncated last-chunk, check `provisional` vs `confirmed` buckets in the billing ledger and compare `session_hint` and `tracelet_id`.
Sasha: We should also add a sampled flag to the trace so we can join router -> runtime -> ledger with a single query. Right now joins are messy in Kibana.
Jon P: Agreed. Minimal changes: 1) ensure `session_id` is included on resume events 2) mark resume-origin in ledger rows 3) add a console annotation for "likely resume double-count" when provisional increases >= threshold within 30s of a resume event.
Kevin L: For telemetry: propose an ES query for a quick look: `GET /_search {"query": {"bool": {"must": [{"match": {"event":"SESSION_RESUME"}}, {"range": {"@timestamp":{"gte":"now-1h"}}}]}} }` then join on `tracelet_id`.
Maria G: Implementation notes: runtime already emits `resume_reason=truncation` and `resume_offset`. We just need to thread `session_id` and `client_session` into the ledger producer, and add a boolean `resume_mark` field.
Sasha: UX: Console should show a transient banner on the customer's per-route view: "Activity shows session resumes — some provisional charges may be temporary. See reconciliation docs." With a link to the runbook.
AJ: Rollout plan: feature-flag telemetry additions, ship sampling for 1% of traffic for two days, validate join rate between router logs and ledger rows, then enable 100% for a week and add console annotation.
Jon P: Acceptance criteria: join rate >95% for sampled traces, no increase in weigher latency >2ms, and a dashboard panel that shows provisional delta vs resume events.
Maria G: I'll open a PR for telemetry schema changes. Kevin, could you add the `resume_mark` column in the ledger schema proposal?
Kevin L: On it.
AJ: One more ask — include a short audit event when we've converted provisionals to confirmed after reconcile, so the console can flip the UI state.
Sasha: Good call. That'll make the UX less noisy.
Maria G: Thanks all. I'll drop the initial PR link here when ready.
ops-bot: incident#824 updated: labels added [telemetry, billing, console]
